title: Fertilia: Update 8
author: BYTE Play Devs
excerpt: Christmas Event: Part 2 is here! Fight two new bosses, unlock expensive new weapons, choose your team and much more!

content.html: The Christmas Event: Part 2 is here!
Let the FESTIVE CRATE decide YOUR FATE! What team will you get?
Open the FESTIVE CRATE to get your team!
What team will YOU get?
Farm for your team and battle it out!
Farm FESTIVE crops to contribute points!
Every 30 minutes, points are RESET!
Everyone on the winning team gets the LIMITED FESTIVE GIFT!
Contains tons of new and limited goodies!
The losing team will receive a +1% bonus. This will stack until they win again!
Limited drops requiring high skill!
Can be spawned from the regular boss menu with candycanes!
The Grinch Boss spawns his minions, his own sleigh and can even STEAL YOUR HELD ITEM (for a limited time!)
As you progress through the boss stages, the Grinch randomly drops items.
At the end, the top damager of the boss fight receives extra goodies!
Launch powerful snowballs at enemies!
This new weapon can be found at the Santa Shop, boss drops and more!
The newest and greatest melee weapon.

Level up this holiday season!
Everyday, the Advent Elf moves somewhere on the map.
Claim a free overpowered item everyday!
Includes candycanes, apple of riches, EXCLUSIVE raffle tickets, crop duster boosters, blast tokens, christmas potions and MUCH MORE!
Claim items everyday through to Jan 1!
Cheap, yet incredibly overpowered!
Purchase the 5x Advent Elf on the server store to receive a TOTAL OF 5 ITEMS EVERYDAY!
This purchase sits at just $5.99 and stays til Jan 1!
PLUS: Includes a BONUS Exclusive Chorus Flower AND 3x Exclusive Raffle Tickets!

items: Shiny Quest reroll cost 2,000 Gems → 1,000 Gems
Increased amount of items from Christmas Trees hourly
Added claim all mail button in Mailbox
Wither Armor from Wither Skeleton Jockey chances 1% → 10%
Removed Infinity Hoe, Diamond Delirium from Exclusive Raffle
Temporarily added some Christmas Armor/Weapons to Exclusive Raffle
Crop Races should finally pay the winner a Race Crate
Added Gem and Rebirth leaderboard crown suffixes
Lightspeed Potion 8x Tier 4 Speed Potion → 6x Tier 4 Speed Potion
Godluck Potions should now be craftable
Recoded Potion Combine system from ground up, should be much smoother
When converting potions in potion combine, lack of space will now go to Escrow
Tier 4 potion name fixes, old ones will be replaced when in inventory on rejoin
Added a hard cap to Rainbow Token cost of 64x

content.text: A few new things with a lot of fixes!!
